basic_info.description: Views! Views! Views! Welcome to 1530 Jones Street, Unit #4, a charming 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home nestled in the heart of San Francisco's prestigious Nob Hill neighborhood. Built in 1910, this residence seamlessly combines classic architectural details with modern amenities, offering a unique urban living experience. Step inside to discover a thoughtfully designed space featuring a updated kitchen and bathroom, providing contemporary comfort while preserving the home's historic character. Large windows bathe the interior in natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. But let's talk about the VIEWS! Incredible, unobstructed Coit Tower views from both the bedroom and living room. A post-card like view that has to be seen to be believed! The unit also includes garage parking for one car. Situated with a high walkability score to the Financial District, North Beach, Polk Street along with proximity to the Hyde Street Cable Car, this location provides unparalleled access to a variety of amenities, including gourmet restaurants, boutique shops, and vibrant cultural attractions. Experience the best of San Francisco living at 1530 Jones Street, Unit #4where historic charm meets modern convenience.
